name: Layout Row (Container)
description: Maps to a MUI Grid container. Groups layout-cell atoms into a responsive row.

resolvestyles.description: true when style must be dynamically resolved via appendprops.style (see molecules/dynamic-style-by-pagemode.json).

resolveprops.description: true when props (not just style) must be dynamically resolved, e.g. inside a list row template using this.* context.
